## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach taken.

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --all-targets --all-features --locked`
- [ ] Documentation and examples were updated when behavior changed.

## Compatibility and security

- [ ] Public API and behavioral compatibility were considered.
- [ ] Inputs, resource limits, and sensitive-data handling were considered.
- [ ] The change contains no generated artifacts, credentials, or private test data.
